source_quality: good — clear text extraction, standard formatting, some OCR artifacts in equations
task_reconstruction: Analyze Wordle puzzle data: (Q1) forecast reported results and identify Hard Mode attributes, (Q2) predict try-count distributions, (Q3) classify words by difficulty, (Q4) explore additional features.
contributions: ARIMA(0,1,1) for Wordle participation forecasting with 80% prediction interval
Word attribute system + LightGBM revealing lag HM% as dominant predictor
GBDT+MMoE multi-task learning for 7-way try distribution (MSE=145)
K-means + LightGBM two-stage difficulty classification (70% accuracy)
Honest reporting of failed data augmentation attempt
assumptions: Twitter reported results represent all players
Word difficulty proportional to average tries
data_and_preprocessing: Wordle.xlsx provided by contest. Outlier removal via scatter plot inspection. First-order differencing for stationarity. Post-May-16-2022 truncation for variance stability.
verification: ADF test for stationarity, AIC/BIC for ARIMA order, MSE for distribution prediction, elbow+silhouette for clustering, classification accuracy for difficulty labels, sensitivity analysis on confidence interval and feature perturbation.
results_trace: ARIMA(0,1,1) produces prediction interval [10139.23, 30808.07] for March 1 2023
Lag HM% dominates word attribute importance for Hard Mode prediction
MMoE outperforms GBDT baseline (MSE=145 vs higher)
Data augmentation increases noise, fails to help
K-means yields 4 difficulty clusters; EERIE classified Group 2

writing_logic.overall_flow: Linear progression: Q1(time series) → Q1(attributes) → Q2(distribution GBDT) → Q2(distribution MMoE) → Q3(classification) → Q4(features) → sensitivity → strengths/weaknesses → memo
key_transitions: From ARIMA results to word attributes via 'find out the possible attributes'
From GBDT to MMoE via multi-task learning upgrade
From distribution prediction to classification via cluster-on-distributions
writing_logic.argument_structure: Each model section: concept definition → method → implementation → results → evaluation

language_observations: Concept-first openers in model sections (textbook definition → application)
Visual → statistical confirmation transitions ('To ensure our judgment')
Inline metric embedding in prose ('with MSE of 145')
Former/latter paired comparison for method contrasts
Direct weakness admission without defensive framing
visualization_observations: Scatter+smooth line with red outlier dots for data exploration
Elbow method + silhouette score dual validation for K-means
Distribution comparison figures for EERIE prediction plausibility
judge_relevance_hypotheses: Multi-model pipeline addressing all sub-questions shows completeness
Honest reporting of failed data augmentation shows integrity
Quantified uncertainty (prediction intervals, accuracy acknowledgment) shows statistical maturity
MMoE architecture shows awareness of advanced ML techniques
weaknesses: No external factor modeling (social media trends, word virality)
Data augmentation attempt was naive and counterproductive
Visual outlier removal is subjective (no formal statistical criterion)
GBDT baseline metrics not clearly reported for comparison
independent_extensions: Add social media trend features (Google Trends, Twitter activity) to ARIMA
Use formal outlier detection (IQR, z-score) instead of visual
Try SMOTE or conditional GAN for better data augmentation
Use entropy of try distribution as alternative difficulty measure
Add confusion matrix and per-class metrics for classification evaluation
